content:
1. Investment Breakpoints
    Priority: E2 > E3 > E0
    E2: High consistency; frequent Long Blade nukes & reliable Short Blade STR stacking.
    E3: Superior boss-killing power via massive Exalt scaling.
    E0: Viable for support; weak as a main carry.
    Avoid: OE/AA (prohibitive Aliemus requirement for OE; AA is whale-only/unnecessary).

2. Essential Teammate Profiling
    Card Draw: Direct card draw for Lotan.
    STR Buffs: Essential scaling source for damage output.
    Arithmetica Gen: Offsets high costs of rapid Short/Long Blade chaining.
    Debuffs: Single Awakener applying Vulnerable/Weakness for max damage and damage reduction.
    Aliemus Gen: Critical for triggering/sustaining Exalt windows post-fusion.
    Strike Synergy: Uniques or secondary effects scaling on Strike cards.

3. Core Mechanics & Skills
    Strike: (E2) Generates Short Blade if hand is empty.
    Defense: (E2) Generates Long Blade if hand is empty.
    Short Blade: Grants permanent STR & builds Exalt charge.
    Long Blade: AOE nuke. Cost scales down per Strike played 

    Exalt (Great Blade: Whalefall):
        Unlock: Short Blade (2x) -> Upgraded Short Blade -> Long Blade.
        Penalty: Replaces all cards with Deadly Assault, draining 10 Aliemus per teammate per card until depleted. Lotan cannot deal alternative damage while Whalefall is active in hand.
        Execution Tip: Do not trigger the final Long Blade unless Aliemus is secured and Exalt can be deployed immediately (or within 1–2 turns with death-resist). Scales also off damage dealt  by boss (post-unlock)

4. Gameplay Loop
    Always: Prioritize and activate Lotan's Keystone immediately (doubles all damage).
    Bosses: Spam Short Blade: Devour to stack STR until Long Blade: Perish hits 0 cost / one-shots, or finish via Exalt.
    Mobs: Secure Long Blade (via Defense, teammate cards, Exalt, or Key 3) and stack STR via Short Blade for one-hit clears.

5. Posse: Mouse's Wisdom (+3 Arithmetica)
